decisions.decision: Board consensus to hold a regular meeting on 12/22/14 and include discussion of the Village District Bylaw at that meeting.
decisions.quote: board consensus was to have a regular meeting on 12/22/14 and include discussion of the village district bylaw

decisions.decision: Board priorities set in order: 1) design of parking spaces, 2) signs, 3) design bylaw.
decisions.quote: prioritization as follows: #1- design of parking spaces #2- signs #3- design bylaw

decisions.decision: Economic development action plan put on hold until after the Village District Bylaw; an economic development committee to be formed, and A. Burney to pursue this with the Town Manager.
decisions.quote: it should be put on hold until after the village district bylaw and that an economic development committee should be formed. a. burney will pursue with the town manager.

decisions.decision: Pavement markings on Reservoir Road referred to the DPW Director as an operational issue.
decisions.quote: that the dpw director will look into that - it is an operational issue.

decisions.decision: Focus to be placed on fine tuning the Village District Bylaw and selling it to citizens; solar and signs unlikely for spring town meeting.
decisions.quote: focus needs to be placed on fine tuning the village district bylaw and "selling" it to the citizens.

decisions.decision: Whites Woods letter of credit funds to be released once the as-built is received.
decisions.quote: funds will be released once as-built is received.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: MRPC, due to state cuts, is no longer planning to relocate and is looking at a budget deficit of the figure printed.
budget_items.quote: due to finances surrounding state cuts, mrpc no longer planning to relocate. looking at a $7ok budget deticit.

budget_items.topic: Building Reuse Committee recommendation for consultant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Committee recommended to the Capital Planning Committee that a sum be set aside for a consultant to look at Town buildings.
budget_items.quote: committee made a recommendation to the capital planning committee that $28k be placed aside for a consultant to look at the town buildings.

budget_items.topic: Smart Growth School Cost Reimbursement received

budget_items.quote: the town has received smart growth school cost reimbursement in the amount of $183,618.00.
